Usage: agentcage cage logs [OPTIONS] NAME

  Show journalctl logs for a cage.

Options:
  -s, --service [cage|egress]
  -n, --lines, --tail INTEGER     Number of lines to show (alias: --tail, like
                                  docker/podman).  [default: 50]
  -f, --follow                    Stream logs in real time.
  --since TEXT                    Show entries since a time, journalctl syntax
                                  (e.g. '10 min ago', 'today', '2026-05-29
                                  14:00'). Not supported on apple-container.
  -l, --severity [debug|info|warning|error|critical]
                                  Minimum severity level to show.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
